engines: deterministic lexical retrieval: 0.70 token TF-IDF cosine + 0.30 char-trigram cosine
budget_rule: For each k, each engine MUST emit exactly k unique IDs from the same visible candidate ontology. Invalid or fewer/more outputs fail that fixture for that k; do not backfill outside the engine.
comparison_rule: Only same-k values may be compared. The historical 30-vs-19 emitted-candidate recall delta is non-comparative diagnostic evidence and must not be used as a superiority claim.
freeze_rule: Prompt, grammar, deterministic scorer, fixture, model, and metrics are frozen before rerun. No post-result tuning.
